news.contents: San Francisco wide receiver Christian Kirk (knee) underwent surgery on his meniscus and could miss most of, if not all of, the rest of the season. He previously dealt with a hamstring injury, returned for Week 7, then got injured and was placed on the injured reserve list for the second time this season. He averaged just five yards per reception Sunday, while rookie Kenyon Sadiq continues to compete for playing time.
